title: HUSD-VMS01 Control Risk — Door Access Unreachable

fields.subject: FW: Urgent: HUSD-VMS01 Control Risk – 08:09
fields.note: The HUSD-VMS01 server (10.72.10.10) is now unreachable from the network. The remote door control interface is locked. We cannot verify if the external doors are locked or unlocked. The attacker may have disabled the fail-safe. Physical checks required.
fields.signature:
Victor Han
Chief Technology Officer
Halverson Unified School District

original.subject: Critical: Door Control Interface Unresponsive
original.body: HUSD-VMS01 (10.72.10.10) — Door status for all 14 schools is now unverified. Remote access to door control panels has failed. Last known state: all doors locked. No heartbeat from field controllers since 08:04. Manual override required. Verify fail-safe status at each school. HUSD-VMS01 is offline. Contact Facilities Branch Director immediately.

instructorNote: This inject confirms the loss of network control over external doors. The CTO must alert Facilities and SRO to begin manual door checks. The threat of unauthorized entry is now active.
